intro: Mark Zuckerberg's AI strategy is facing widespread skepticism among consumers and industry observers despite his continued investment in the vision. OpenAI disbanded its preparedness team as the company moves toward an IPO, while Anthropic's Dario Amodei acknowledged that AI companies including his own have failed to deliver on their promises. Stripe is reportedly acquiring AI gateway startup OpenRouter for over $7 billion, signaling major consolidation in the AI infrastructure space.
